evidence.observation: Pressure was 2.979 Torr before growth at 100 sccm Ar.

Pressure reached 3.298 Torr despite stable Ar flow (100.3 sccm), temperature (750.2 C), and low oxygen (4.7 ppm); this suggests an exhaust conductance or pressure-control problem, not an identified specific fault.

args.missing_evidence: Expected growth-stage pressure profile and pressure-control settings; independent pressure confirmation and exhaust/pump checks to distinguish blockage from pumping or gauge faults. Sample characterization is not yet available.
